name: WF3 — Reminders (paid without page > 24h)

parameters.query:
WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT
    o.id,
    o.code,
    o.buyer_email,
    o.buyer_name,
    'reminder:' || o.id::text AS dedup_id
  FROM orders o
  LEFT JOIN pages p ON p.order_id = o.id
  WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    AND p.id IS NULL
    AND o.paid_at IS NOT NULL
    AND o.paid_at < now() - interval '24 hours'
),
claimed AS (
  INSERT INTO webhook_events (id, source)
  SELECT dedup_id, 'reminder' FROM candidates
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT c.id, c.code, c.buyer_email, c.buyer_name
FROM candidates c
JOIN claimed cl ON cl.id = c.dedup_id;

nodes.name: Claim Pending Reminders
nodes.notes: Atomically claims reminders using webhook_events as a dedup store: key reminder:<order_id> + ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. Choice: at most ONE reminder ever per order (see README section 7).

_comment: Daily cron: claims and emails buyers whose order is paid but still has no page after 24h. Dedup via webhook_events keyed reminder:<order_id> with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, so an order receives at most one reminder ever. To allow one reminder per day instead, change the key to reminder:<order_id>:<YYYY-MM-DD> using to_char(current_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD').
